name: credit_note_create
description: Issue a credit note against one invoice: the whole invoice, a gross amount, or named lines with quantities. Line totals are stored negative in minor units and the invoice's VAT rates are reused.

arguments.name: invoice
arguments.desc: The invoice number to credit, e.g. INV-2026-0001

arguments.name: reason
arguments.desc: Why the money is being given back, e.g. "returned goods" or "billed twice". Printed on the document

arguments.name: amount_minor
arguments.desc: Credit this GROSS amount, VAT included, in minor units. Split across the invoice's VAT rates in proportion to each rate's share of the total

arguments.name: lines
arguments.desc: Credit only these invoice lines. Leave out with amount_minor for a full credit note

arguments.name: issue_date
arguments.desc: YYYY-MM-DD, defaults to today in your business profile's timezone

arguments.name: notes
arguments.desc: Free text printed under the totals

name: credit_note_list
description: Every credit note with its invoice, client, reason and negative total. Filter by invoice number, by client or by issue date range.

arguments.name: invoice
arguments.desc: Only credit notes issued against this invoice number

arguments.name: client
arguments.desc: Only credit notes for clients whose name contains this text

arguments.name: from
arguments.desc: YYYY-MM-DD, earliest issue date

arguments.name: to
arguments.desc: YYYY-MM-DD, latest issue date

name: credit_note_get
description: The full stored record for one credit note: every negated line, the VAT lines, the totals, the reason and the invoice it was issued against.

arguments.name: id
arguments.desc: Credit note id such as CN-2026-0001, or an exact client name

name: credit_note_pdf
description: Call this tool to write the A4 PDF of one credit note and return the file path. The invoice layout, titled CREDIT NOTE and carrying the invoice number it reverses. Pro.

arguments.name: id
arguments.desc: Credit note id such as CN-2026-0001

arguments.name: out_path
arguments.desc: Where to write the file. Defaults to the billing-docs data directory under pdf/

name: credit_note_text
description: Turn a credit note into a plain-text summary with the negated line table, the VAT lines, the total and the invoice it reverses, ready to paste into an email. Free on every tier.

arguments.name: id
arguments.desc: Credit note id such as CN-2026-0001

arguments.name: greeting
arguments.desc: Opening line, default "Hello" plus the client name

arguments.name: sign_off
arguments.desc: Closing line, default your business name from the shared profile

name: purchase_order_create
description: Order from a supplier: line items with quantity and unit price in minor units, VAT, a currency and an expected delivery date. You are the buyer, from the shared business profile.

arguments.name: supplier
arguments.desc: Supplier name or client id. A name the invoice server already knows brings its address, email and VAT id onto the order

arguments.name: items
arguments.desc: What is being ordered

arguments.name: currency
arguments.desc: Defaults to your business default currency

arguments.name: expected_delivery_date
arguments.desc: YYYY-MM-DD, when the goods or work are due

arguments.name: issue_date
arguments.desc: YYYY-MM-DD, defaults to today in your business profile's timezone

arguments.name: discount_percent
arguments.desc: Discount applied to every line, in percent

arguments.name: tax_rate
arguments.desc: VAT percent for lines with no rate of their own. Defaults to the business default

arguments.name: notes
arguments.desc: Free text printed under the totals, e.g. delivery address or terms

arguments.name: supplier_email
arguments.desc: Only if the user gave it; otherwise the stored client's email is used

arguments.name: supplier_address
arguments.desc: Postal address for the SUPPLIER block, newlines allowed

arguments.name: supplier_vat_id
arguments.desc: Supplier VAT / tax registration id

name: purchase_order_list
description: Every purchase order with its supplier, total, expected delivery date and status (open, partially received or received). Filter by status, by supplier or by order date range.

arguments.name: status
arguments.desc: Default "all"

arguments.name: supplier
arguments.desc: Only orders to suppliers whose name contains this text

arguments.name: from
arguments.desc: YYYY-MM-DD, earliest order date

arguments.name: to
arguments.desc: YYYY-MM-DD, latest order date

name: purchase_order_get
description: The full stored record for one purchase order: the buyer and supplier blocks, every line with its unit price and VAT, the totals, the expected delivery date and what has been received.

arguments.name: id
arguments.desc: Purchase order id such as PO-2026-0001, or an exact supplier name

name: purchase_order_pdf
description: Call this tool to write the A4 PDF of one purchase order and return the file path. The invoice layout, titled PURCHASE ORDER, with the buyer, the supplier and the delivery date. Pro.

arguments.name: id
arguments.desc: Purchase order id such as PO-2026-0001

arguments.name: out_path
arguments.desc: Where to write the file. Defaults to the billing-docs data directory under pdf/

name: purchase_order_text
description: Turn a purchase order into a plain-text summary with the line table, the VAT lines, the total and the delivery date, ready to paste into an email to the supplier. Free on every tier.

arguments.name: id
arguments.desc: Purchase order id such as PO-2026-0001

arguments.name: greeting
arguments.desc: Opening line, default "Hello" plus the supplier name

arguments.name: sign_off
arguments.desc: Closing line, default your business name from the shared profile

name: purchase_order_receive
description: Record that a purchase order arrived, in full or in part. A partial receipt keeps the order open and is kept on the record with its date and note; a full receipt closes it.

arguments.name: id
arguments.desc: Purchase order id such as PO-2026-0001

arguments.name: partial
arguments.desc: True when only some of the order arrived. The order stays open and can be received again. Default false

arguments.name: date
arguments.desc: YYYY-MM-DD, defaults to today

arguments.name: note
arguments.desc: What arrived, e.g. "8 of 10 units, 2 back-ordered"

name: billing_docs_report
description: What has been credited back per currency, against how many invoices, and what is still on order per currency, with the purchase orders whose delivery date has passed. Pro.

arguments.name: from
arguments.desc: YYYY-MM-DD, earliest document date to count

arguments.name: to
arguments.desc: YYYY-MM-DD, latest document date to count

name: license_status
description: Show whether this server runs in free or Pro mode and where to upgrade.

name: license_activate
description: Activate a Pro license key (format MCPL1.xxx.yyy). Verified offline and saved locally.

arguments.name: key
arguments.desc: License key from the checkout confirmation page
